description: This file defines a Flow struct and associated methods for managing conversational flows within a Mattermost plugin, including HTTP initialization, step management, and state handling.

classes.name: Flow
classes.description: A struct managing a multi-step conversational flow within a Mattermost plugin, including state management, HTTP routing, and step transitions.

methods.name: NewFlow
methods.description: Creates a new Flow instance with a unique name, API client, plugin ID, and bot user ID.

methods.name: WithSteps
methods.description: Adds ordered steps to the flow.

methods.name: OnDone
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be called upon flow completion.

methods.name: InitHTTP
methods.description: Initializes HTTP routes for button and dialog handling.

methods.name: WithDebugLog
methods.description: Enables debug logging of the flow state.

methods.name: ForUser
methods.description: Creates a flow instance for a specific user.

methods.name: GetCurrentStep
methods.description: Retrieves the current step name in the flow.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the flow with an initial application state.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Completes the flow and calls the done callback if set.

methods.name: Go
methods.description: Transitions the flow to a specified step, handling post actions and state updates.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next step name after a given step.
